notes: Corrected on the same point as v. 9: in both measurement chains the single written *the* goes to the present article morpheme on the rectum, fronted onto the construct, rather than to a supplied article beside an `unrepresented` present article (rule 29, with rule 47 choosing the first of the two articles).
The predicate copula *was* joins the first numeral phrase under rule 20; the gapped second clause writes none.
*the eleven curtains* is a different case: no article morpheme stands there, so the supplied *the* belongs to the noun (rules 15, 46).
